svg.desc: Step-specific guided recreation. Not a genuine screenshot or live result.
svg.text: INSTRUCTIONAL MOCKUP — NOT A LIVE CAPTURE OR RESULT
Create the application VM
Your Windows 10 host · VMware Workstation Pro 17
VMware Workstation Pro 17 — Windows host
File Edit View VM Tabs Help
New Virtual Machine / Virtual Machine Settings
Name: TLS-APP01 Guest: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9 64-bit
Memory: 2048 MB Processor: 1 processor / 1 core
Disk: 30 GB growable [ ] Allocate all disk space now
CD/DVD: your verified RHEL 9 x86_64 ISO
Temporary installation: NAT; later select Custom VMnet6
Next / Finish
EXPECTED RESULT / SIMULATED CLUE — CHECK YOUR OWN MACHINE
Library contains a new TLS-APP01 VM with 2 GB RAM, one vCPU, a growable disk and the RHEL ISO.
FOLLOW THE NUMBERED INSTRUCTIONS IN THE LESSON
1. On Windows, open VMware Workstation Pro. In Library, leave your existing VMs alone.
2. Click File, then New Virtual Machine. Choose Typical and click Next. Choose I will install the
operating system later.
3. Choose Linux, then Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9 64-bit. Name this new VM TLS-APP01.
4. Choose a 30 GB virtual disk and leave Allocate all disk space now unchecked if shown. Split versus
single file does not decide whether it is growable.
5. Click Customize Hardware. Set Memory to 2048 MB, Processors to one virtual processor with one core,
Network Adapter to NAT temporarily, and CD/DVD to the downloaded RHEL 9 ISO.
6. Click Close, then Finish. The 30 GB is a growth limit, not a promise that the host needs no free
space; leave space for updates and snapshots.
No real private key, real certificate result, production access or DoD endorsement is shown.
